optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Finance Operations Analyst, Credit Workflow System

professionalSummary.text: Seasoned finance operations professional with over two years of ownership of the disbursement reconciliation control for a commercial bank’s credit book, consistently leading month‑end close activities and maintaining robust control evidence.
professionalSummary.witness: Led the month-end disbursement reconciliation close for the credit book at a commercial bank for twenty-two months, as the named control owner in the finance control register, running the close timetable and signing the close-out checklist.

experienceHighlights.text: Owned the disbursement reconciliation control, approving adjustments up to a delegated limit of 25,000 and escalating larger items to the finance controller.
experienceHighlights.witness: Held a delegated approval limit of 25,000 for reconciliation adjustments, approving adjustments within the limit in the reconciliation tool under my own user id and escalating larger ones to the finance controller with a proposed treatment.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the reconciliation procedure and assembled the monthly control evidence pack for internal audit, including adjustment logs, sign‑off records and break ageing reports.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the reconciliation procedure and assembled the control evidence pack each month for internal audit, including the adjustment log, the sign-off record and the break ageing report.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated the month‑end close timetable with treasury and credit operations, clearly delineating responsibility boundaries for funding entries and disbursement queues.
experienceHighlights.witness: Agreed the close timetable each month with treasury and the credit operations team, recording in the close plan that treasury owned the funding entries and credit operations owned the disbursement queue.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented known limitations and hand‑over conditions at each month‑end, ensuring transparent transition of responsibilities.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included control ownership, adjustment approvals within limit, procedure maintenance and evidence packs for the disbursement reconciliation over about two years.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Control register entry naming the candidate as control owner, signed close‑out checklist, and adjustment log with user‑id approvals, providing verifiable evidence of control ownership and adjustment approvals.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the control register entry naming the candidate as control owner, one month's signed close-out checklist and the adjustment log showing approvals under the candidate's user id, with the reconciliation tool's record identifiers as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s ownership of the disbursement reconciliation control, month‑end close leadership, delegated approval authority, procedure maintenance, evidence packaging, timetable coordination, and documentation of limitations. No evidence is provided regarding other unrelated responsibilities or personal attributes.
